thread:
ops_denise: Alert: after yesterday's firewall tighten + scheduled KMS rotation, we're seeing a burst of GPU node warmup failures in us-west-2. warmup_success ~45% for cold starts.

infra_paul: seeing lots of 'tcp timeout' to privatelink endpoints in the artifact-proxy and 'kms decrypt: AccessDenied' spikes during node bootstrap.

sre_anya: node traces show kubelet waiting on model blobs while keystore client retries; nodes eventually join but cold-start latency is terrible (>2m).

security_jim: the new egress policy reduced conntrack buckets on the privatelink NATs to limit blast radius. rotation + warmup fanout looks like it exceeded conntrack headroom causing SYN/handshake drops.

ops_denise: immediate ask: short-lived TF firewall exception for svc:gpu-warmup -> privatelink CIDRs for 20m so handshakes can finish. need signoff.

security_jim: approve 20m TTL if created via terraform with an audit reference to the rotation ticket. add expiration metadata.

infra_paul: TF snippet ready, will annotate: `tmp-allow-warmup-1737012468` and apply to canary in 3m.

deploybot: canary apply queued to us-west-2-canary (10 nodes).

sre_anya: quick workaround pushed to canary: enable local artifact cache and shorter backoff so warmup retries locally before hitting privatelink. patch: `kubectl patch ds gpu-warmup -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"infra/warmup-cache":"true"}}}}}'`. Canary success jumped to ~94%.

infra_paul: medium-term: 1) stagger KMS rotations by region/az to avoid global handshake storms, 2) increase conntrack autoscale thresholds on privatelink NATs, 3) consider regional keystore proxies to reduce cross-region decrypts.

security_jim: will update rotation playbook to require a pre-check on privatelink conntrack headroom before broad rotations.

ops_denise: monitoring tasks: add alerts for `gpu_warmup_success_rate < 0.85 for 5m`, `privatelink_conntrack_util > 0.9`, and `kms_decrypt_access_denied > 3/min`. also tag logs with `mitigation_ticket=1737012468`.

sre_anya: canary healthy, rolling exception to region. will follow up with incident summary and postmortem owner.
